faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Glenayre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Glenayre. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Glenayre a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Glenayre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Glenayre over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Glenayre compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, Glenayre held 7.4% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Glenayre than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 5 in June to 10 in September 2026 (+100.0%).
